info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Subsidiaries API

items.docs:
Returns legal-entity subsidiaries for the authenticated organization.
Use this to discover subsidiary UUIDs before calling endpoints that accept subsidiary_id (contracts, invoices, reports).
Each subsidiary carries currency and timezone used for localized accounting and reporting.

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: UUID of the subsidiary to retrieve (must belong to the organization).

items.docs:
Returns one subsidiary by id for the authenticated organization.
Call list-all-subsidiaries first if you need to resolve which subsidiary id to use.
